name: Gaming & Sports Betting
description: Simulates a real-time sports betting platform with live odds updates, bet placement with wallet balance contention, payout processing, and leaderboard queries. Tests high-contention writes (wallet updates), real-time reads (live odds), and transactional integrity (bet placement must check balance atomically).

setup_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS players (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), username STRING NOT NULL UNIQUE, wallet_balance DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1000.00, total_bets INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_wins INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, vip_level STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'bronze', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_players_vip (vip_level))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), sport STRING NOT NULL, event_name STRING NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live', home_odds DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL, away_odds DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL, draw_odds DECIMAL(6,2), start_time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_events_sport (sport), INDEX idx_events_status (status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bets (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id), event_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES events(id), bet_type STRING NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, odds DECIMAL(6,2) NOT NULL, status STRING NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending', potential_payout DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL, placed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), INDEX idx_bets_player (player_id), INDEX idx_bets_event (event_id), INDEX idx_bets_status (status))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaderboard (id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), player_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES players(id), period STRING NOT NULL, total_wagered DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_won DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, net_profit DECIMAL(15,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE INDEX idx_leader_player_period (player_id, period))
seed_sql: INSERT INTO players (id, username, wallet_balance, vip_level) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), 'player_' || generate_series::STRING, 1000.00 + (random() * 9000)::DECIMAL(15,2), CASE (generate_series % 4) WHEN 0 THEN 'bronze' WHEN 1 THEN 'silver' WHEN 2 THEN 'gold' ELSE 'platinum' END FROM generate_series(1, 200)

INSERT INTO events (id, sport, event_name, status, home_odds, away_odds, draw_odds) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), CASE (generate_series % 4) WHEN 0 THEN 'football' WHEN 1 THEN 'basketball' WHEN 2 THEN 'tennis' ELSE 'esports' END, 'Match ' || generate_series::STRING, 'live', 1.5 + (random() * 3)::DECIMAL(6,2), 1.5 + (random() * 3)::DECIMAL(6,2), 2.0 + (random() * 4)::DECIMAL(6,2) FROM generate_series(1, 50)

operations.name: place_bet
sql: UPDATE players SET wallet_balance = wallet_balance - $1, total_bets = total_bets + 1 WHERE id = $2 AND wallet_balance >= $1
INSERT INTO bets (player_id, event_id, bet_type, amount, odds, potential_payout) VALUES ($2, $3, $4, $1, $5, $1 * $5)

operations.name: live_odds
sql: SELECT id, sport, event_name, home_odds, away_odds, draw_odds FROM events WHERE status = 'live' ORDER BY start_time DESC LIMIT 20

operations.name: update_odds
sql: UPDATE events SET home_odds = $1, away_odds = $2, draw_odds = $3 WHERE id = $4 AND status = 'live'

operations.name: player_bets
sql: SELECT b.id, b.bet_type, b.amount, b.odds, b.status, b.potential_payout, e.event_name, e.sport FROM bets b JOIN events e ON e.id = b.event_id WHERE b.player_id = $1 ORDER BY b.placed_at DESC LIMIT 15

operations.name: process_payout
sql: UPDATE bets SET status = 'won' WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE players SET wallet_balance = wallet_balance + $2, total_wins = total_wins + 1 WHERE id = $3

INSERT INTO leaderboard (player_id, period, total_won, net_profit) VALUES ($3, 'daily', $2, $2) ON CONFLICT (player_id, period) DO UPDATE SET total_won = leaderboard.total_won + $2, net_profit = leaderboard.net_profit + $2, updated_at = now()

operations.name: leaderboard_query
sql: SELECT p.username, p.vip_level, l.total_wagered, l.total_won, l.net_profit FROM leaderboard l JOIN players p ON p.id = l.player_id WHERE l.period = 'daily' ORDER BY l.net_profit DESC LIMIT 50
